task.question: What opens at São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport in February 2026?
task.evidence: 21 February – GRU Airport People Mover opens in São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport.
task.sonnet_answer: Terminal 4 at São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport is scheduled to open in February 2026.

answer:
The São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport will have its People Mover system opening for the general public on February 20, 2026. 

FINAL: People Mover system

[Guarulhos Airport People Mover Now Open to Public] https://www.riotimesonline.com/sao-paulo-guarulhos-airport-people-mover-aeromovel-cptm-2026 São Paulo # São Paulo’s Guarulhos Airport People Mover Finally Carries Riders By Isabel Rojas · June 26, 2026 · 5 min read São Paulo's Guarulhos Airport People Mover Finally Carries Riders Photo: mehmetkali, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons São Paulo Key Facts —Now open. The People Mover at São Paulo’s main international airport began carrying the general public on February 20, after years of delay. [...] The project has a long history of slipping dates. Construction began in June 2022, with the line first promised for 2024, then pushed repeatedly through 2025 and into 2026. Building an automated railway through a working airport added difficulty at every step. Safety and logistics constraints came with keeping the terminals running throughout. [...] The opening is real but partial. The train first ran in December for airport staff only, then opened to the general public in February on restricted hours. For the time being it runs at reduced capacity, with the rollout staged as certification continues. Full operation, with both trains running and longer hours, is expected in the second half of the year.
